function: Learns the transmission mode (direct satellite link or UAV relay) and the power and bandwidth requested on S-G, S-A and A-G links for SAGIN downlink (pp. 6-8).
system: LEO satellite (550 km) with 3 UAV relays and 10-20 ground UEs; 28 GHz and 2 GHz bands; antennas not stated (scalar link gains); no RIS (pp. 3, 11).
method: MCTS: per-UE hybrid actor-critic (P-DQN style; deterministic Actor outputs power/bandwidth, Critic picks discrete mode) with QMIX mixing network as centralized Critic; multi-agent RL, centralized training, decentralized execution (pp. 7-10).
data_channel: Own simulator: LEO links with free-space loss and shadowed-Rician fading, UAV links with LoS-probability model and Nakagami-m fading; random-walk UEs; parameters in Table I (pp. 4, 11).
test_conditions: Convergence at 12 UEs; sweeps over 10-20 UEs, A-G bandwidth 2-4 MHz, UAV power 5-25 W in the same simulator; retraining per setting not stated (pp. 12-14).
baselines: Learned only: H-QMIX (greedy nearest-UAV choice plus QMIX allocation), P-QMIX (probabilistic action transformation [8]), P-MADDPG; no purely non-learned or optimization baseline (p. 11).
metrics: Overall transmitted data (successfully delivered packets), energy efficiency, spectrum efficiency, power utilization, bandwidth utilization, episode reward (pp. 11-14).
complexity: Analytical complexity orders: training O((I zeta_agent + zeta_m) floor(T_tot/tau)), execution O(I zeta_agent); joint critic O(I k) instead of O(k^I); no runtime (pp. 8, 10-11).
q1_support: p. 4: "typically modeled by a shadowed rice fading channel [41]" for the satellite link and Nakagami-m shadowing for the UAV links; an own simulator (Table I, p. 11), no 3GPP TR 38.811 model and no measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "training episodes when there are 12 UEs" and p. 13: "as the number of UEs increases from 10 to 20"; the paper never states that a model trained in one setting is tested in another, nor reports fine-tuning or transfer.
q3_support: p. 11: "H-QMIX is a semi-learning transmission strategy, where a greedy policy is adopted for transmission node selection"; P-QMIX and P-MADDPG are learned, and no fully non-learned or optimization baseline is compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "the time complexity of the proposed MCTS in Training stage can be expressed as" zeta_train = O(...); p. 11: "the computational complexity is only related to the number of operations of the local agents".
q5_support: p. 11: "The simulations are implemented using Pytorch Version 1.13.1" is the only implementation statement; no repository, DOI or public dataset is given, and the data come from the authors' own simulator (Table I).
notes: Included, area 6: learned power and bandwidth control on satellite and UAV links, jointly with the transmission mode, so it passes above_phy (Actor outputs power and bandwidth, pp. 7-8, 10). PDF is the paper of the DOI (title and DOI on p. 1). q3 is 0 because H-QMIX is semi-learning (greedy nearest-UAV plus QMIX allocation) and acts like an ablation, leaving no non-learned baseline; reviewer may confirm. q2 is 0 because train and test conditions are not separated in the text. Tables I and II and Figs. 4-7 were read as page images.
